notes.title: Game Update
notes.content:
[b][u]Game Updates[/u][/b]

[u][b]Multiplayer[/b][/u]

. New lobby system
. Players are now able to play with up to 3 players

[u][b]Maps[/b][/u]

. Size of Cave and Hedge have decreased
. Cropfield lanterns on floor were removed 
. Orb Locations moved around
